label: The same blackness on Europe seen on New York's financial buildings

aliases: The same black that is on Europe is on America's financial buildings

label: America at Epcot and the 250 years
description: Placed at Epcot at Disney World in the spirit, seeing the American pavilion and saying it is about the two hundred and fifty years. He asks the audience who have been there to picture it and offers no further reading.
aliases: I'm at Epcot and I see American Epcot

label: An earthquake shaking Florida and registering to Alaska
description: An earthquake described as shaking Florida, Miami and Tampa, with the charts registering clear up into Alaska, which he calls substantial.
aliases: Shakes Florida. Shakes Miami. And Tampa
it went on the charts clear up into Alaska

label: People burning things in New York wearing a green shirt
description: People seen burning things in New York wearing a green shirt, which he says he does not know the meaning of and which his son was looking up. Later joined to a planned staged event in New York on a greater scale than the 2020 riots, involving all races and marked by green.
aliases: you saw the people burning in New York, with the green shirt
I don't know what the green shirt represented

label: An invitation to hold arena meetings in Colombia if he wins
description: A figure who says that if he wins the election he will invite him to hold major Holy Ghost meetings in an arena in Colombia and accommodate him in any way possible, for salvations, healings and miracles.
aliases: if he wins the election he's invited me to hold major Holy Ghost meetings
he would accommodate him in any way possible

label: The turtle in the glasses is Germany
description: A turtle wearing glasses, seen in an earlier vision alongside doves and black crows trying to tear out the heart of the dove, identified here as Germany.
aliases: There's the turtle. Who is that? That's Germany
